note: Phase 9 - B2, B3 and C5: the three task types the series had never used, the verification rebalance, and the calibration essay. Matching sentence endings, one set a book in Volumes 1 to 6, each a new reading passage with a lettered bank of endings and more endings than questions. Listening plan and map labelling with a lettered plan, one set a book from Volume 3, which is where that task actually lives in the real paper. Fifty-six items retyped: thirty-two in Volume 1 asked about the writer's views while being labelled True/False/Not Given and are now Yes/No/Not Given, and twenty-four factual sentence-completion items in Volumes 2 to 6 and the two Foundation books are now True/False/Not Given, so that both verification types are taught in every book. One calibration Task 2 at the end of Foundation 2, at the real paper's 250 words. Four figures added, one plan a book from Volume 3.
